name: Personal Bank: refuses swapping equipped items or withdrawing into equipment slots
contract: #12460: AscensionPersonalBank::HandleSwapItems must allow only player inventory positions (Player::IsInventoryPos or AutoStore NULL_BAG/NULL_SLOT), matching stock GuildHandler::HandleGuildBankSwapItems. Dragging an equipped item onto a non-equipment item in the Personal Bank (or withdrawing a bank item directly onto an equipment slot) must be rejected so the equipped item stays worn and the bank item stays in the bank, while ordinary auto-store withdrawal to bags still succeeds.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the vault summon land in the world
Equip the shirt in the shirt slot
SETUP: the shirt is equipped in slot 3
Deposit the Righteous Orb into bank slot 0
SETUP: the Righteous Orb is stored in the bank
DISCRIMINATING: drag equipped shirt onto the Righteous Orb in bank slot 0
Let the server process the rejected deposit-swap
The equipped shirt stays in slot 3
The Righteous Orb is not moved out of the bank
Control: normal auto-store withdrawal to bags still succeeds
The Righteous Orb returns to the player's bags
The equipped shirt remains untouched in slot 3
